scripts.app:pubget: cd apps/gym_app && fvm flutter pub get
scripts.app:analyze: cd apps/gym_app && fvm flutter analyze lib test
scripts.app:build:web: cd apps/gym_app && fvm flutter build web --release --dart-define=APP_FLAVOR=production --dart-define=FIREBASE_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY=6LddO5otAAAAANe-6ZBAhGUrt87kjNLqiXbbfx8o
scripts.console:pubget: cd apps/platform_console && fvm flutter pub get
scripts.console:analyze: cd apps/platform_console && fvm flutter analyze lib test
scripts.console:build:web: cd apps/platform_console && fvm flutter build web --release --dart-define=FIREBASE_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY=6Ld5H5otAAAAAIbKG4fZKbr6EDlvFDaIxivRAFvP
scripts.build:web: npm run app:build:web && npm run console:build:web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --project createmix-in --only hosting:gym-app,hosting:platform-console
scripts.emulators:test: sh scripts/firebase-with-java.sh emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-gym-dev 'npm --prefix firebase/functions test'
scripts.emulators:seed: sh scripts/firebase-with-java.sh emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-gym-dev 'npm run seed'
scripts.infra:check: npm run infra:fmt && npm run infra:validate && node scripts/verify-portability.mjs
scripts.seed: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-gym-dev npm --prefix firebase/functions run seed
